text:
oliver: Quick thought after reading the latest postmortem thread 1. We keep accumulating action items with no clear follow-through. Proposal: define a simple remediation velocity metric and an owner escalation policy.

rachel: Remediation velocity = closed_remediations / week? Feels useful if we label card state consistently.

maya: Agree. Suggest fields on each remediation card: owner, priority (P0-P3), estimate (days), status, tags. Then velocity measured as sum(estimate_completed)/week or number_closed/week.

sam: I like a separate escalation timeline too: if owner hasn't moved card in 48h -> auto-assign to secondary, if no progress in 7 days -> notify manager and mark for sprint planning.

oliver: Proposed owner SLAs by priority: P0 -> 24h acknowledgement, 72h mitigation plan; P1 -> 48h ack, 7d plan; P2/3 -> 5d ack, 14d plan. Keep it strict but reasonable.

oncall-bot: NOTE: We can auto-post ack reminders via the incidents webhook. See /webhooks/remediation-ack.

kai: To catch recurring patterns, suggest a monthly "recurrence heatmap" dashboard that aggregates tags across remediations (capacity, cache-stalls, ci-regression, config-drift, 3p). Heatmap helps prioritize cross-cutting fixes.

rachel: Also add a "recurrence_count" integer on the card so we can sort boards by repeat offenders. Teams can request a deep-fix if recurrence_count > 3.

maya: Process proposal for rollout:
- Phase 0 (1 week): start tagging all new remediation cards with priority + tags + owner + estimate.
- Phase 1 (weeks 2	6): run remediation velocity dashboard and trial the 48h escalation.
- Phase 2 (after 6 weeks): evaluate on recurrence heatmap and adjust SLAs.

sam: I'll script a GH Action to add reminders and update secondary owners based on card inactivity. Will prototype in a forked board.

oliver: IC rotation tweak: keep weekly IC but add a "shadow IC" who follows the incident life cycle for continuity. Shadows switch every two weeks.

kai: For comms cadence, recommend the minimal set: incident summary to #product within 1h, interim note when mitigation in place, final postmortem link in 72h, and a remediation board snapshot in the weekly ops notes.

rachel: Action items from this thread:
- sam -> prototype GH Action for inactivity -> due by Fri
- maya -> publish owner SLA doc and template remediation card fields -> due Tue
- kai -> build recurrence heatmap query for Grafana (tags + counts) -> due next Wed
- oliver -> draft escalation flow chart and share for feedback -> due Thu
Trial period: 6 weeks, measure remediation_velocity and recurrence_count trends.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: "remediation-process-kickoff" in 3 days (participants: oliver, rachel, maya, sam, kai).

sam: Done: created demo board and added three sample cards with the fields we discussed. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure-remediations-demo (placeholder).

maya: Great. Let's start Phase 0 tomorrow and keep updates short in the weekly ops note.

oliver: Thanks all. If we hit obvious blockers during Phase 0, call a 15m quick triage rather than letting cards pile up.

rachel: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 6 weeks."
